title: Counting Isomorphism Classes of Spanning Trees of Complete Bipartite Graphs
summary: Spanning trees of complete bipartite graphs exhibit a rich interaction between degree sequences and graph structure. In this paper, we obtain lower bounds on the number of isomorphism classes of spanning trees in $K_{a,b}, 2 \leq a \leq b$ in terms of $P_a(a+b-1)$ and $P_b(a+b-1)$ where $P_k(m)$ is the number of integer partitions of $m$ of length $k$. Furthermore, we obtain an upper bound in terms of $a$ and $b$.
